entries.speaker: Arsène
entries.en: I am [clr 1]Arsène[clr 27]—the other you who[n]exists within...

entries.speaker: Arsène
entries.en: Though I may disappear this moment,[n]I shall always be at your side.

entries.speaker: Arsène
entries.en: We shall meet again... when your fate[n]reaches its conclusion.
